nodes.name: mcu_side_ldo
nodes.description: XC6206 LDO generates VCC_3V3_MCU from external VIN_5V. Powers STM32F103 MCU and supplies VCC1/VCC2 for the MCU-side ISO7721 digital isolator. Requires input and output bypass capacitors.

nodes.name: mcu_core
nodes.description: STM32F103 MCU operates at 3.3V (VCC_3V3_MCU). Configures SPI interface for ADS1118 ADC. SPI signals (SCLK, CS, MOSI, MISO) are routed to the isolation module. BOOT0 tied low for Flash boot mode. NRST requires pull-up and capacitor.
ARM Cortex-M3 MCU

nodes.name: digital_isolation_mcu_side
nodes.description: First ISO7721 dual-channel digital isolator. Channels connect MCU-side SPI outputs (SCLK, CS) to isolated-side outputs. VCC1 powers from MCU-side 3.3V (VCC_3V3_MCU). VCC2 powers from isolated-side 3.3V (VCC_3V3_ISO). Requires bypass capacitors on both supplies. This module defines the isolation boundary.
Dual-channel digital isolator

VCC2 powers from isolated-side 3.3V (VCC_3V3_ISO). Requires bypass capacitors on both supplies. This module defines the isolation boundary.

nodes.name: adc
nodes.description: ADS1118 16-bit SPI ADC on isolated side. Operates at 3.3V (VCC_3V3_ISO). Receives isolated SPI commands (SCLK, CS, DIN) and returns data on DOUT. One analog input (AIN0) connects to the 5V reference (VREF_5V). Requires bypass capacitor on VDD. GND pin connects to ISO_GND.
16-bit SPI ADC on isolated side
